baseline.what: main on 2026-11-21: task set 2.2.1 with the fiber-bundling-05 reference

frozen.reason: the released task directories, generated and never edited by hand: the bytes every reported result was graded on, each directory with its DIGEST
each puzzle task's texts as they ship, its goal pictures and its instance lock: mk_tasks.py renders the task directories from them
the puzzle reference trajectories: copied into each task's solution/ and read by roboarc.load_reference()
the pinned tooling, the graders and the standard service: copied unchanged into every puzzle task, docstrings and comments included
the release record (version, runtime, tooling hashes, each base's evidence): rendered into every puzzle task, and a new `version` re-renders every README and DIGEST
the pins of the frozen instances: each runtime binding is written from them and checked against them, and the release image is built from them
the eai-standard/2.4 client and service layer, and the client base image (client.env): copied unchanged into every standard task
the resource monitor's code: inject.py copies these three files unchanged into every task
each task's minimum compute, limits and caps: rendered into task.toml, the README and the monitor's limits
the agent's egress allowlist: the generators write this list into every task.toml (the script around it may change)
the released images by manifest digest: every Dockerfile and compose file of a task names its images by these digests
the release image's version: rendered into every puzzle task's image reference
the IKEA tooling, grader and video renderer: copied unchanged into every IKEA task
the IKEA standard service, its grader, rigs and reference maker: its files are copied unchanged into every IKEA standard task
the IKEA reference trajectories: copied into each task's solution/ (the build scripts next to them are not shipped)
each IKEA task's title, goal and success requirements in words: rendered into its instruction and README
what the IKEA image's scenes build to (image id, initial-state hashes): rendered into each task's runtime binding
the IKEA privileged tasks' oracle and nop records: rendered into each README
the IKEA standard tasks' oracle and nop records: rendered into each README
the sha256 of every scene file in the IKEA image: rendered into each task's runtime binding and README, and checked when the image is built
the IKEA images' recipe, versions and scene code: the scene files are in the released image under the hashes of assets.json, the versions are in every IKEA task
the simulator source the release image installs: its hash (SOURCE.json) is in every puzzle task's runtime binding and a Session refuses another
the robot models and textures in the release image: a change is a new image version
the release image's recipe and the scripts it installs (stage_instance.py, the MuJoCo patch, prune.py): a change is a new image version
which files of source/ the release image takes: a change is a new image version

generators.reason: renders the puzzle tasks: its constants (the time cutoff, the texts' facts) are in every one
writes the sections every task shares (limits, time limit, external material) and the DIGEST
wires the resource monitor into every task and holds its image pin
